summary: Phase-5 Iteration-3 (Execution+DualMode+Replay) testing complete. All 22 backend tests passed covering: A1/A2/A3/A4 infrastructure readiness with venue-context error contracts, B Spot/Futures dual-mode backend with /api/user-risk/preview, B3 test-order routing with venue+leverage context, C1/C2/C3 replay backend with 1m/5m/15m/1h timeframes and SIM_NEW/SIM_FILLED/SIM_CANCELED lifecycle states. Frontend verified: User Exchange Settings dual-mode UI correctly shows/hides futures controls based on market_type (spot hides leverage/margin_mode/position_side, futures shows all). Admin Exchanges page loads with full CRUD. No regressions detected.

integration_issues.issue: Console shows 404 errors for favicon/static assets during page load - not API failures

critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/exchange/test-order failure response correctly includes normalized failure_code + venue context (exchange, market_type, environment)
GET /api/exchange/readiness-checklist correctly supports exchange, market_type, environment params and returns venue context fields
GET /api/user-risk/preview correctly returns null for futures-only fields (leverage, margin_mode, position_side, liquidation_buffer, margin_usage) when market_type=spot
GET /api/user-risk/preview correctly returns all futures fields when market_type=futures with configurable leverage/margin_mode/position_side
POST /api/backtest/replay/run supports 1m, 5m, 15m, 1h timeframes (4h and other intervals rejected)
Replay executions correctly use SIM_NEW, SIM_FILLED, SIM_CANCELED lifecycle states
Frontend dual-mode UI correctly adapts controls: spot mode hides futures-only controls, futures mode shows leverage/margin_mode/position_side inputs
Test order result card shows venue context fields (exchange, market_type, environment, failure_code)
seed_data_creation: User venue assignment for TEST_phase4iter2_pipeline@example.com to binance (spot+futures, testnet) verified from previous iteration
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase-5 Iteration-3 execution infrastructure, dual-mode, and replay features fully tested. Key behaviors verified: (1) test-order failure contract includes failure_code + venue context, (2) readiness-checklist supports venue params, (3) risk preview null futures fields for spot / populated for futures, (4) replay supports 1m/5m/15m/1h timeframes with SIM lifecycle states, (5) frontend dual-mode UI adapts controls correctly. Valid Binance testnet key NOT available so test-order returns blocked/invalid_key which is expected per requirements.
